items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Abe Lyman; the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not mention Abe Lyman directly nor describe a personal interaction, only responding to the interviewer's narrative about the event.

ctx.x: I think Duke has drawn something like 70. He's drawn 17,000. He had three bands. Now you think of these 100,000 people so they put it in Madison Square Garden. And that was the first Haywest Moon Ball. I think that was Henderson in '35 and I may be a liar for a couple of years.
Was this one in Central Park was opposite Abe Lyman anyway?
Yes. I think Abe Lyman's band but I think we did the same thing in Madison Square Garden.
